events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival of Music & Art took place in Bethel, New York, starting on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibe
angles.copy: 57 years ago, half a million people descended on a dairy farm in upstate New York for three days of peace, love, and music. What's your favourite iconic Woodstock moment or performance?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on this day in 1977. He would have been 91.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the one and only King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley. His music and legend live on. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Influential rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas on this day in 1996, passing away a few days later. He would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur, who was shot on this day in 1996. His powerful lyrics and artistry continue to resonate. What's your favourite Tupac track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970. He would have been 84.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who left us too soon on this day in 1970. His guitar mastery continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Album
angles.copy: 57 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. From that legendary zebra crossing cover to timeless tracks, it's an album that defines an era. What's your favourite song from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and fierce rock 'n' roll spirit continue to captivate. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The voice of a generation, still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite track he's been on?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Song
angles.copy: 51 years ago, John Lennon released 'Imagine', a song that continues to inspire hope and unity worldwide. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple changed personal music forever. What was the first album you loaded onto your shiny new iPod?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global celebration of the James Bond film franchise, marking the release date of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Theme
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From Shirley Bassey to Billie Eilish, the Bond theme songs are as iconic as 007 himself. Which one is your all-time favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the life and enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedic icon John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From 'Ministry of Silly Walks' to 'Fawlty Towers', he's given us endless laughs. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Impact
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. Its eclectic mix and experimental sound proved their boundless creativity. What's your favourite hidden gem from the album?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on this day in 1991. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who left us in 1991. His voice and stage presence remain legendary. What's your favourite Queen anthem?
